import os
from google.cloud import kms_v1
from google.protobuf.wrappers_pb2 import BytesValue

def encrypt_payload(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    project_id = config.get("project_id") or os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT")
    location_id = config.get("location_id", "global")
    key_ring_id = config.get("key_ring_id")
    crypto_key_id = config.get("crypto_key_id")
    plaintext = payload.encode("utf-8") if isinstance(payload, str) else payload
    client = kms_v1.KeyManagementServiceClient()
    key_name = client.crypto_key_path(project_id, location_id, key_ring_id, crypto_key_id)
    result = client.encrypt(request={"name": key_name, "plaintext": plaintext})
    return result.ciphertext
